ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65-70% high-intensity (white) pixels dominating the lateral lobes versus 30-35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and inner lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black wedge extending from the peduncle to the median notch; white contiguous regions across both lobes; scattered black focal spots and linear streaks localized in the lower quadrants and along the trailing edges; visible yellowish-brown pigmentation smudge in the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; approximately 55-degree angle with a well-defined pixel depth dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations; right lobe shows higher-amplitude jagged peaks along the distal margin; left lobe transition from smooth mid-section to serrated distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive dark linear streaks (rake marks) observed; multiple vertical streaks on the right lobe and finer horizontal/diagonal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters at lobe tips; significant rake mark scarring across both lobes; localized yellowish-tan discoloration (likely diatom accumulation) on the inner right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique intersecting 'X' shaped linear pigment pattern on the upper third of the right lobe.
